Each course requires **categoryidnumber**: either a single Moodle course category **idnumber**, or a comma-separated hierarchy path (each segment is resolved as a child category idnumber under the previous parent). Example `MAIN` or `MAIN,SCI,CS,2026S1`.

Optional **gradeCategories**: array of grade category definitions applied after the course is created. Each item uses **`name`** (category title in the gradebook); `idnumber` is **not** used. Duplicate names in the same course are rejected.

requestBody.description: JSON body with `courses` array. Each course item must include `categoryidnumber` (single idnumber or comma-separated path).

post.description: Multiple status values can be provided with comma separated strings

Enrols one or more users into courses using the **manual** enrol plugin.

Request body: **`enrolments`** — array of enrolment objects.

Each enrolment requires **`roleshortname`** (Moodle role short name from the `role` table), **`username`**, and **`courseshortname`**.

**Applicable role shortnames (examples — your site may define additional roles):**
- **`student`** — student
- **`editingteacher`** — teacher (can edit course content)
- **`teacher`** — non-editing teacher

Optional per enrolment: **`timestart`**, **`timeend`** (Unix timestamps; omit or `0` for open-ended), **`suspend`** (`1` to create a suspended enrolment).

The WS token must be sent in the **Authorization** header (`Bearer`), not in the JSON body.

Response: single object with **`message`** summarizing the **last** enrolment processed (implementation processes items sequentially).

post.summary: Unenrol users from a course (manual enrol)
post.description:
Removes users from courses via the **manual** enrol plugin (`unenrol_user`).

Request body: **`enrolments`** — array of objects. Each object requires **`username`** and **`courseshortname`**.

**`roleshortname`** is optional in the external API signature but the server implementation resolves the role by short name before unenrolling — **you should send it** (same values as enrol). Examples only:

- **`student`** — student
- **`editingteacher`** — teacher (editing)
- **`teacher`** — non-editing teacher

Bearer token in **Authorization** header, not in JSON body.

Response: single object with **`message`** — reflects the **last** row processed (same pattern as enrol_users).

Note: The implementation message text uses the spelling **unnrolled** (server output).

categoryidnumber.description: Single Moodle course category idnumber, or comma-separated path from root (each segment is an idnumber under the previous parent).

gradeCategories.description: Optional. Grade categories to create after the course is created; each item uses `name` (not idnumber).

categoryidnumber.description: Single Moodle course category idnumber, or comma-separated hierarchy path (same as create courses).

gradeCategories.description: Optional. Grade categories to add to the duplicated course; each item uses `name` (not idnumber).

CourseGradeCategory.description: Grade category payload for create/duplicate course. Moodle grade category **fullname** is set from `name`. No `idnumber` field — do not send grade category idnumbers here.

name.description: Display name of the grade category (maps to Moodle grade category fullname). Must be unique among new items for that course; must not match an existing grade category name in the target course.

grademax.description: Optional. Maximum grade for the category item (default 100 if omitted).

aggregationcoef2.description: Optional. Weight / aggregation coefficient (see Moodle gradebook settings).

categoryidnumber.description: Resolved Moodle course category idnumber for the created course (leaf category after resolving the path).

Enrollment.description: Legacy schema name — prefer EnrolUsersEnrolment / EnrolUsersRequest for enrol_users documentation.

enrolments.description: One or more manual enrolments to apply.

roleshortname.description:
Moodle role short name (must exist on the site and be assignable in the course context).
Examples only: **`student`** (student), **`editingteacher`** (editing teacher), **`teacher`** (non-editing teacher).

username.description: Moodle username of the account to enrol.

timestart.description: Optional. Unix timestamp when enrolment starts; omit or `0` for default.

timeend.description: Optional. Unix timestamp when enrolment ends; omit or `0` for no end.

suspend.description: Optional. Set to `1` to enrol as suspended.

message.description: Info message from the server (covers the last enrolment in the batch).
message.example: user student01 was enrolled at COURSE101 with role ofstudent

enrolments.description: One or more manual unenrol operations.

roleshortname.description:

post.description:
Fired when a student receives a grade for a quiz, assignment, or other graded activity.
The event is published to the Medad Fusion Publish Events API.
The payload includes the student's course/category/activity grades and the grade category branch
that contains the activity, with each category's total grade.
